product.name: Monoprice Black Back In-Ceiling Speakers 6.5in Fiber 2-Way with Covered Crossover (pair)
product.description: In‑ceiling speakers are the ideal combination of sound quality and styling. Rather than cluttering the room with large box speakers trailing speaker wires, the speakers are virtually invisible, while filling the room with high fidelity audio. Featuring a removable and paintable grille, this 2‑way speaker uses a woofer cone made with DuPont™ Kevlar® fiber, with a rubber surround for deep, impactful bass, and a Silk Titanium tweeter for sweeter and smoother high frequencies.
